title: IC10 instructions from a mod
description: Instructions a Stationeers mod adds to IC10. The IC10 extension for VS Code reads this file from enabled mods' folders, from packages named in ic10-lint.json, and from the ic10.lsp.instructionFiles setting.

name.description: The mod's name, shown in each instruction's hover ("From the mod …") and in messages.

modId.description: Only in the extension's own catalogue (mods/): the <ModID> in the mod's About/About.xml, for mods that don't ship this file themselves.

instructions.description: Each instruction by name. Names are case-sensitive, as in the game; one of the game's own names is ignored.

description.description: What it does, for hovers and completion.

operands.description: Its operands in order. Optional ones come last.

name.description: Shown in hovers and hints, e.g. a(r?|num).

type.description: What it takes, in the game's help spelling, |-separated: r?, num, int, id, d?, logicType, slotLogicType, batchMode, reagentMode, str. A number also takes a register.

role.description: read (the default); write: the register it sets (only the first operand); jump: where it jumps to (a line, label or register).

into.description: A read operand whose value the instruction also puts in this register (r0 to r15), like a call's arguments. So a function reading that register isn't flagged as reading it before it's set.

flow.description: How control leaves it. jump: always to the jump operand (like j). branch: there or on to the next line (like beq). call: there, coming back to the next line (like jal). return: back after the call (like j ra). halt: stops (like hcf). Leave it out for an instruction that runs on to the next line.
